description: Evidence-backed value of one metric for one area in one month: value, regional (regionPercentile: within the area's region, London for a London area; rankScope names it) and England percentiles, quality, sample size, category breakdown where available, plus up to 12 prior months as evidence rows. Units follow the metric (per 1,000 residents, GBP/m2). Confidence is high only for observed (not modelled) values. Some metrics are published for a wider area (income per MSOA; rent change and mobile coverage per borough): on a smaller area they return the enclosing area's value with quality 'fallback' and carrierGeographyId naming where it came from. Period defaults to the metric's latest. The find_areas factors disorder, epc-share, leasehold-share and schools are read the same way for one neighbourhood (latest value, period ignored), to verify or explain a find_areas result.

metric_id.description: Metric id from list_metrics, e.g. crime or price-per-square-metre.
metric_id.title: Metric Id

period.description: Month, YYYY-MM. Defaults to the metric's latest period (defaultPeriod in list_metrics).
period.title: Period
